name: libdisplay-info
description: Library for parsing and interpreting EDID and DisplayID monitor descriptor blobs, exposing display name, supported modes, and color characteristics. Used by wlroots' DRM backend to query connected display capabilities.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
